targetTexts.1: Listen, my sons, to a father’s instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
targetTexts.2: For I give you sound teaching; do not abandon my directive.
targetTexts.3: When I was a son to my father, tender and the only child of my mother,
targetTexts.4: he taught me and said, “Let your heart lay hold of my words; keep my commands and you will live.
targetTexts.5: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or turn from them.
targetTexts.6: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.
targetTexts.7: Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
targetTexts.8: Prize her, and she will exalt you; if you embrace her, she will honor you.
targetTexts.9: She will set a garland of grace on your head; she will present you with a crown of beauty.”
targetTexts.10: Listen, my son, and receive my words, and the years of your life will be many.
targetTexts.11: I will guide you in the way of wisdom; I will lead you on straight paths.
targetTexts.12: When you walk, your steps will not be impeded; when you run, you will not stumble.
targetTexts.13: Hold on to instruction; do not let go. Guard it, for it is your life.
targetTexts.14: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.
targetTexts.15: Avoid it; do not travel on it. Turn from it and pass on by.
targetTexts.16: For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; they are deprived of slumber until they make someone fall.
targetTexts.17: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
targetTexts.18: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
targetTexts.19: But the way of the wicked is like the darkest gloom; they do not know what makes them stumble.
targetTexts.20: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
targetTexts.21: Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart.
targetTexts.22: For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.
targetTexts.23: Guard your heart with all diligence, for from it flow springs of life.
targetTexts.24: Put away deception from your mouth; keep your lips from perverse speech.
targetTexts.25: Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
targetTexts.26: Make a level path for your feet, and all your ways will be sure.
targetTexts.27: Do not swerve to the right or to the left; turn your feet away from evil.
